name: Jesse Ngo
life: “I still remember smiling through the day we ran out of towels.” People around Juniper Street know Jesse by a small Wednesday habit. Jesse knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I told tourists everything was normal because I needed their tips. Today I wrote the closing date on the board.
appearance: Jesse is easy to recognize by close-cropped dark curls and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in a dark green knitted vest with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair, Jesse counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices when listening.
personality: Jesse enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Jesse is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To post the real closing date for visitors.
family: Eden Fisher is Jesse’s stepsibling. Jesse chooses the music. Eden puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *A boat for sale twice*, Eden says, “I can afford half a boat. I asked another bidder what half a Saturday looks like.”
connections: Terry Fong. A server putting the date on a board helps a teacher stop selling lessons after that date.

reactions.situation: Two workers are offered one extra paid week
reactions.response: Jesse asks both workers what commitments they made on the strength of the old end date.

reactions.situation: A diner goes silent in the middle of a noisy family celebration
reactions.response: Jesse asks one close relative to check in privately instead of stopping the party for a public inquiry.
